evals.prompt: Quero criar um plugin simples que tenha uma skill para ensinar boas praticas de code review no meu time. So precisa da skill, nada mais.
evals.expected_output: Should scaffold a minimal plugin with .claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/code-review-practices/SKILL.md. Should NOT add hooks, commands, agents, or MCP. plugin.json should have correct structure. SKILL.md should have name + description frontmatter only.

evals.prompt: Minha skill de meeting-notes esta em ~/.claude/skills/meeting-notes/ e funciona bem no Claude Code. Quero transformar em um plugin para distribuir pro meu time no Cowork. O que preciso fazer?
evals.expected_output: Should explain the porting workflow: create plugin structure, adapt SKILL.md frontmatter, simplify language for non-devs, add commands as shortcuts, package as .plugin. Should reference cowork-guide.md. Should mention sandbox limitations. Should NOT use technical jargon when describing Cowork-facing changes.

evals.prompt: Criei um plugin mas a skill nao esta sendo ativada quando eu peco coisas relacionadas. O que pode estar errado?
evals.expected_output: Should provide systematic debugging: check frontmatter (name + description only), verify description has specific trigger phrases, confirm SKILL.md is in skills/ at root (not inside .claude-plugin/), check YAML syntax, suggest restart/reload-plugins. Should reference the debug workflow from SKILL.md.
